amendments.text: The 3x3 grid needs an 80x80 window inside the bbox. The Midd2 yellow-object bbox is 96x48 px, so no grid point fits; the fallback is the centre template (median == centre). No threshold was touched, and the row is now marked non-evaluable instead of 'zero-change control'.

A negative disparity is impossible in rectified stereo with a positive baseline. The Monopoly grid's -18 px sample is a matcher artefact; dropping it leaves {71, 421} -> median 246, MAD 175, |421-246| = 175 < 525, so the block's centre is NO LONGER an outlier. P-tmpl-1 is therefore reported PARTIAL, not PASS. The fix claim for the block (P-tmpl-2) also does not survive the filter (rel 0.717), so it stays FAIL.
The estimator used the templates that fit: 12 rows x 9 + Monopoly x 3 + Midd2 x 1 = 112 template matches, not 14 x 9 = 126. 'median-of-9' was sloppy wording for 'median of the available templates'.
Grid composition and GT-in-grid table, added after the run because it explains the partial fix: every row has at least one template within +-5 px of the true disparity.

amendments.text: (i) 'the 6 rows without bboxL' -> 5 rows have no bboxL and 1 (Bowling1 white pin) has a bbox but no rel_err (degenerate disparity, -26 px); exclusion is by missing rel_err. (ii) '~2 px shift' -> mean -1.3 px, largest two are -6 px (157->151) and -3 px (132->129). (iii) 'centre lands on background' -> the centre match is a NEARER, low-NCC (0.435/0.574) surface (0.99 m / 0.51 m against GT 3.01/3.08 m), i.e. the matcher locked onto a spurious patch; 'outlier' is the measured claim, 'background' was an unmeasured gloss.
